correctness.rationale: Explicit bias-to-slope surjection realizes every pair in (0,1)^2. Direct fixed-point differentiation yields H1 and H2, strict concavity in s, and monotonicity of the remaining rational function in t. Independent symbolic matrix differentiation, exact-equilibrium finite differences, and deterministic high-precision tests confirm the derivation; computation is not used to infer continuum completeness.
